description: Convert between Western (Gregorian) dates and Japanese era dates (wareki: Meiji, Taisho, Showa, Heisei, Reiwa), using exact era start dates and "gannen" (元年) for year 1. Give either date (YYYY-MM-DD), or wareki such as "令和元年5月1日" / "R1.5.1", or era + year + month + day. Rejects dates that do not exist in that era (e.g. Heisei 31-05-01). Range 1873-01-01 to 2200-12-31.

era.description: 明治/大正/昭和/平成/令和 or Meiji/Taisho/Showa/Heisei/Reiwa (use with year, month, day).

wareki.description: Japanese era date to convert to Western, e.g. "令和元年5月1日", "平成31年4月30日", "S64.1.7".

year.description: Year in the era (1 or "元" for the first year).

name: convert_japanese_era
title: Japanese Era (Wareki) Converter
